description: This file defines Redux action creators related to user authentication and initial data fetching in a React-Redux application.

methods.name: setAuthStatus
methods.description: Creates an action to set the user's authentication status and email.

methods.name: fetchInitialData
methods.description: Asynchronous thunk action that fetches user data and dispatches multiple actions to update the store.

methods.name: initialDataStatus
methods.description: Creates an action to update the status of initial data fetch.
